test: update G1 lock prefetch and known kernel cfg contracts

The real G0 run found a stale call to the removed root-lock prefetch API and a global ELF-path count that omitted the newly retained artifact. Exercise the actual preparation entry point against its immutable Git seed and audited derived lock, including rejection of a changed locked-fetch input, and check the hash/probe/artifact consumers explicitly.
